What if you slept on your stomach every night?
Side sleeping is the most common position, but plenty of people sleep face down. Lots of people love it. It can feel cozy, and it may even reduce snoring for some people.

But here's the twist. To breathe, you have to turn your head to the side for hours, which twists your neck and flattens the natural curve of your spine. That's why it's called the hardest position on your back. If you can't quit, try a thin pillow under your head and another one under your hips.
